headline: Explicit statistical and mechanistic models infer regulatory, spatial and copy-number structure from expression data
label: Mechanistic Models Of Expression
summary: New models span ODE, network-topology, Bayesian and causal frameworks, plus cross-species and stress resources for single-cell transcriptomic inference.
synthesis: The common thread is explicit model structure applied to expression data to recover regulatory or causal organization. A topology study finds feedback loops restore heterogeneous expression from homogeneous populations. A semi-mechanistic ODE model fitted to RNA-seq derives zebrafish maternal-to-zygotic transition expression clusters. Echidna jointly infers copy number alterations from scRNA-seq and bulk WGS across samples and treatment time points. Causal-discovery algorithms applied to Visium liver data model local and neighbor-derived effects in senescence. A review curates 161 cell-cell communication methods. LACA (134 species) and CellStressDB (131 studies, Geneformer) supply cross-species and stress-response resources. A Shapley-explained ML analysis of CRISPR-Sirius imaging reports chromosome-specific responses to serum starvation, though it is not an expression model. The items address distinct questions and share no single method.
